description:
[Trading Data API] Hyperliquid perpetual context: funding (hourly), open interest, mark/oracle/mid price, premium, 24h volume. Not geo-blocked.

**Example:** `/v1/hyperliquid?symbol=BTC`

Use when you need Hyperliquid perp context: funding, open interest, mark/oracle price, premium and volume. Not for Binance/Bybit aggregates (use funding_oi).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

symbol.description: Required. Hyperliquid coin name (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL).

name: hyperliquid
